sg_law_group_leader_law_womens_suffrage = {
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			sg_law_candidate_law_no_womens_rights = yes
			sg_law_score_law_no_womens_rights >= sg_law_score_law_womens_suffrage
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			sg_law_candidate_law_women_in_the_fields = yes
			sg_law_score_law_women_in_the_fields >= sg_law_score_law_womens_suffrage
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			sg_law_candidate_law_women_in_the_workplace = yes
			sg_law_score_law_women_in_the_workplace >= sg_law_score_law_womens_suffrage
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			sg_law_candidate_law_women_own_property = yes
			sg_law_score_law_women_own_property >= sg_law_score_law_womens_suffrage
		}
	}
}

sg_law_group_leader_law_worker_protections = {
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			sg_law_candidate_law_no_workers_rights = yes
			sg_law_score_law_no_workers_rights >= sg_law_score_law_worker_protections
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			sg_law_candidate_law_regulatory_bodies = yes
			sg_law_score_law_regulatory_bodies >= sg_law_score_law_worker_protections
		}
	}
}
